reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 discusses loading-rate-dependent creep mechanisms in a bulk alloy, not MSRO at interfaces. E2 addresses twinning stresses and elastic undulations, not MSRO evolution. E3 links chemical ordering to elastic strain fields in a different alloy system, not to creep or interfacial plasticity. E4 shows SRO promotes FCC-to-BCC phase transformation, not MSRO coarsening facilitating slip/twinning. The premises are largely unsupported by the provided passages.
